base: All sums of money received and paid out by the fiduciary, with property received or distributed valued as money, excluding specific legacies and devises (SCPA § 2307(1),(2)).

schedules.text: 5% of the first $100,000, 4% of the next $200,000, 3% of the next $700,000, 2.5% of the next $4,000,000, 2% of all sums above $5,000,000; computed one-half on receiving and one-half on paying out (SCPA § 2307(1)).
schedules.capNote: The full commission assumes the whole base is both received and paid out; property not distributed earns only the receiving half.
